# Vidsavey

> Vidsavey is a free online video downloader. Paste a video URL to analyze it, then download the video as MP4, the audio as MP3, or available subtitles — directly in the browser, with no account and no software installation.

Vidsavey supports popular platforms including YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X, Twitch, Reddit, Vimeo, Dailymotion, Bilibili and hundreds more sites powered by yt-dlp. Availability may vary by individual video.

## Pages

- [Home](https://vidsavey.com): Free online video downloader (MP4 / MP3 / subtitles)
- [Privacy Policy](https://vidsavey.com/privacy): How Vidsavey handles information
- [Terms of Service](https://vidsavey.com/terms): Terms and conditions for using Vidsavey

## FAQ

- Is Vidsavey free? Yes, no account required.
- Which platforms are supported? YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, X and hundreds more via yt-dlp.
- Can I download MP3 audio? Yes, when the source provides an audio track.
- Can I download subtitles? Yes, VTT or SRT when available.
- Do I need to install software? No, Vidsavey runs entirely in the browser.
